feedback: The submitted solution does not implement the required LogParser class or its methods (addLog and query). Instead, it defines an unrelated Solution class with a solve method that does nothing. The code fails to parse log entries, store event counts by component path prefix and event type, or respond to queries. As a result, all test cases fail.
optimization_hint: Implement the LogParser class with a trie or hash map to store counts per component path prefix and event type. For each log, split the string to extract component_path and event_type, then increment counts for all prefixes of the component_path. Queries can then be answered in O(1) by looking up the exact (componentPath, eventType) key.
